task-design-provenance.title: Design basis
task-design-provenance.reason.none: No approved design snapshot is recorded for this task.
task-design-provenance.reason.current: The adopted design matches the current task and publication. Dispatch checks execution settings and current access separately.
task-design-provenance.reason.task_chang: The task changed after adoption. New dispatch is blocked until the design is reviewed and adopted again.
task-design-provenance.reason.requiremen: The requirement changed after adoption. New dispatch is blocked until the updated design is reviewed and adopted.
task-design-provenance.reason.publicatio: A different design revision is now published. New dispatch is blocked until it is reviewed and adopted.
task-design-provenance.reason.retired: The design has been retired. New dispatch is blocked until a design is published, reviewed and adopted.
task-design-provenance.reason.excluded: This task was removed from the adopted design scope. New dispatch is blocked until it is explicitly included and adopted again.
task-design-provenance.reason.source_una: The current source or original adoption cannot be verified. New dispatch is blocked.
task-design-provenance.reason.unknown: Current design eligibility could not be determined. Reload the design basis before dispatching.
task-design-provenance.snapshot_unavaila: The original adopted snapshot could not be verified. No replacement text is shown.
task-design-provenance.invalid_read: The design basis does not belong to the selected project and task. Reload to read the current source.
